dependence_sensitivity.null_centering: same as corrected HOLDOUT: center contribution series by observed mean, resample non-overlapping time-order blocks with replacement, one-sided positive-repair p-value
dependence_sensitivity.fdr: BH across the same fixed 13 predictive cells separately at each block length; robustness only, not a new confirmatory hierarchy

temporal_concentration.eligible_cells: the three original confirmatory-pass cells only
temporal_concentration.aggregation: UTC clock-hour bins aligned to top of hour
temporal_concentration.contiguous_period_definition: runs of adjacent occupied UTC clock-hour bins
temporal_concentration.first_second_half_definition: split the used HOLDOUT time interval at its temporal midpoint
temporal_concentration.removal_test: remove the UTC hour with the largest positive contribution sum; do not search alternate block definitions

effect_scale.statistic: TRAIN-controlled covariance between structural signal residual and future target-price-change residual
effect_scale.warning: beta translations are local descriptive probability-response equivalents, not PnL, executable spread, Sharpe, RMSE improvement, or directly realizable edge
